note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for MMSegmentation's PSA-Net with ResNet-50 backbone. No CLI-invocable code exists.
summarize_model_config: summarize the PSA-Net ResNet-50 encoder-decoder model configuration for semantic segmentation
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration used across backbone and heads
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor settings including mean, std, and BGR-to-RGB conversion
review_decode_head_psa: review the PSAHead decode head configuration with bi-directional pixel-wise self-attention
review_auxiliary_head_fcn: review the FCNHead auxiliary head configuration for multi-scale training
